Streaming chat completion that includes a usage summary in the final chunk

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.chat_stream(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'Say hi', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'gpt-4', stream: true, stream_options: LiterLlm::StreamOptions.new(include_usage: true))).to_a
puts result.usage.total_tokens.inspect
```
